objective.revenue_definition: Genuine recurring revenue only: current subscription plus paid succeeded latest invoice charge, excluding fully refunded and inactive/cancelled subscriptions.

diagnosis.reason: The 28-day Search Console aggregate shows 1,565 impressions, 11 clicks and average position 65.99. The JSON Schema Generator remains the largest measured page opportunity at 453 impressions, 0 clicks and average position 68.05; low search visibility remains the earliest measured funnel constraint.

experiments.hypothesis: Removing the repeated search-intent section will make the JSON Schema Generator page less repetitive and strengthen its usefulness and relevance for people seeking a generator from sample JSON.

Aligning the Flatten JSON title, H1, description and related links with measured "flatten json online" intent will improve rankings and produce the first organic clicks without changing tool behaviour.

missing_instrumentation: Indexed target-page count or URL Inspection/index coverage evidence is unavailable.
Workflow completion rate awaits a workflow_start denominator.
Activation/deeper-product/commercial-intent user rates await post-instrumentation activated organic users.

measurement_rules.unknown_values: Keep unavailable measurements as null; never estimate them as facts.

rate_definitions.activation_rate: organic users with successful_tool_use / organic active users
rate_definitions.deeper_product_usage_rate: organic users with workflow_start / organic users with successful_tool_use
rate_definitions.commercial_intent_rate: organic users with commercial_intent / organic users with successful_tool_use
rate_definitions.returning_user_rate: organic returning active users / organic active users

measurement_rules.zero_denominator: A rate remains null when its denominator is zero; zero is never substituted for an unavailable rate.
measurement_rules.experiment_readout: Due 7/14/28-day SEO experiments are classified from the fixed baseline and current 28-day Search Console page evidence. Improving requires a new click or both >=10% impression growth and >=0.5 position improvement; declining is the inverse; otherwise insufficient.
